world.description: Walking and the server's world-event checks (V2_SPEC §4.11).

stepMs.description: Milliseconds per one-tile step (P-51); the walking speed is 1000 / stepMs tiles per second.

turnMs.description: How long a new direction must be held, standing still, before the player walks; a shorter tap only turns (P-51). Client only.

speedTolerance.description: Multiplier on the distance the player could have walked.

speedSlackTiles.description: Extra tiles allowed for network latency.

interactRange.description: Chebyshev distance in tiles for interactions.

budgets.description: Performance budgets (V2_SPEC §4.13). The bundle and asset budgets gate PRs (tools/ci/check-bundle.mjs); the performance budget runs nightly (P-36).

initialJsGzipKb.description: JavaScript the title screen loads, gzipped.

regionAssetsKb.description: Maps and art files of one region.

textureMemoryMb.description: Decoded size (width × height × 4) of one region's images.

audioKb.description: Sound effects plus one region's music in its larger version, as one player downloads them (P-42, P-48).

p95FrameCpuMs.description: 95th percentile main-thread CPU time per frame while walking (animation-frame callbacks: Phaser update and render), P-38.

maxRegression.description: The nightly fails when its p95 CPU time per frame is worse than the last good nightly by more than this share (P-38).

jsHeapMb.description: Used JS heap after walking every area.
